subject: Life Sciences
topic: Human impact, succession and nature-based farming
topicAf: Menslike impak, suksessie en natuurgebaseerde boerdery

options: bare rock or sand with no soil
optionsAf: kaal rots of sand sonder grond
items.explain: Primary succession starts where no soil exists yet.
items.explainAf: Primêre suksessie begin waar daar nog geen grond is nie.

items.q: The first organisms to colonise bare rock, such as lichens, are called:
items.qAf: Die eerste organismes wat kaal rots koloniseer, soos korsmos, word genoem:
items.explain: Pioneers break down rock and begin forming soil.
items.explainAf: Pioniers breek rots af en begin grond vorm.

items.q: Secondary succession after a fire is faster than primary succession because:
items.qAf: Sekondêre suksessie ná ’n brand is vinniger as primêre suksessie omdat:
options: soil and seeds are already present
there are no plants to compete with
optionsAf: grond en sade reeds teenwoordig is
daar geen plante is om mee te kompeteer nie
items.explain: Soil, seeds and roots remain, so plants regrow quickly.
items.explainAf: Grond, sade en wortels bly agter, dus groei plante vinnig terug.

items.q: Which is a nature-based farming practice?
options: crop rotation and using natural predators to control pests
planting one crop on the same land every year with heavy pesticides
optionsAf: om alle inheemse plantegroei skoon te maak
wisselbou en die gebruik van natuurlike roofdiere om plae te beheer
om elke jaar een gewas op dieselfde grond met swaar plaagdoders te plant
items.explain: Working with natural processes protects soil and biodiversity.
items.explainAf: Om met natuurlike prosesse saam te werk, beskerm grond en biodiversiteit.

items.q: Exceeding the carrying capacity of grazing land leads mainly to:
items.qAf: Om die drakrag van weiveld te oorskry, lei hoofsaaklik tot:
options: overgrazing, soil erosion and loss of biodiversity
optionsAf: oorbeweiding, gronderosie en verlies aan biodiversiteit
items.explain: Too many animals remove the plant cover, exposing soil to erosion.
items.explainAf: Te veel diere verwyder die plantbedekking, wat grond aan erosie blootstel.

items.q: In a termite colony, division of labour means that:
options: different castes such as workers, soldiers and the queen do different jobs
optionsAf: verskillende kastes soos werkers, soldate en die koningin verskillende take doen
items.explain: Castes specialise, which increases the efficiency of the colony.
items.explainAf: Kastes spesialiseer, wat die doeltreffendheid van die kolonie verhoog.
